title: allophyllum sinistrum subsp. pinnatisectum
intro: Allophyllum sinistrum subsp. pinnatisectum, commonly known as Western Woolly Blue Curls, is a perennial herb in the mint family native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help alleviate respiratory issues, such as congestion and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Allophyllum sinistrum subsp. pinnatisectum include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which can help soothe irritated tissues and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
